mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 2%, the combination signals an accommodative monetary policy despite inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decline for two consecutive months, the combination signals severe labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is declining, the combination signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 quarters and INDPRO declining
failure_condition: If GDPC1 is negative for 2 quarters and INDPRO is declining and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances.
